invariants.name: invariant_mintDebtAccounting
invariants.description: Outstanding mintDebt + cumulative pulled phUSD equals the exact sum over all dispatches of (amount*ratio)/100 (truncated). No over-mint relative to ratio.

invariants.name: invariant_noPhUSDOverMint
invariants.description: Total phUSD ever minted via pull() never exceeds the cumulative (amount*ratio)/100 debt basis.

invariants.name: invariant_ratioBound
invariants.description: ratio is always <= MAX_RATIO (50); setRatio cannot push it above. NOTE: the documented spec bound is strict (< 50) but the implementation permits == 50 (LOCAL-001 off-by-one); the safety-relevant <= 50 bound holds.

invariants.name: invariant_nftSupplyAccounting
invariants.description: ERC1155 totalSupply(tokenId) == paid mints + free mintFor + migration mints - burns.

invariants.name: invariant_priceMonotonic
invariants.description: Mint price never decreases across paid mints (growth >= 0) and stays >= initial price.

invariants.name: invariant_sUSDSConservation
invariants.description: USDS dispatched is wrapped into sUSDS held by the dispatcher with no value loss/creation; sUSDS shares held == USDS deposited into the wrapper (modulo wrapper share price, 1:1 in the mock).

invariants.name: invariant_migrationConservation
invariants.description: Burn-before-mint conserves total NFT units: V1 units burned via migrate() == V2 units minted via migrate(); no inflation or loss on the happy path.
